content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Moneo issue #227 (configurable speech-to-text for the CHAT MIC only; voice calls/GPT-Live untouched). You build **PR 1 of 4**: the engine contract, the Settings section and the fallback. No local model or OpenRouter yet; later PRs add those on top, so keep the contract clean.

Today the chat mic (lib/ai/use-voice-input.ts, lib/ai/voice-recorder.ts) streams PCM to OpenAI realtime transcription through app/api/voice/session/route.ts. That route uses gpt-live-transcribe with vocabulary hints from lib/ai/voice-vocabulary.ts, and the mic shows live words.

Build:
1. **Engine contract.** Create `lib/ai/speech/` with one engine contract: batch engines take the recorded audio plus hints and return text. The existing OpenAI live path becomes the `openai` engine, with unchanged behaviour. Add engine choice and fallback as a pure, unit-tested function:
   - If the chosen engine is unavailable or fails and an OpenAI key exists, use OpenAI and report that a fallback happened.
   - If there's no key, return a clear reason the mic can't work.
2. **Batch route.** A server route for batch engines (e.g. `app/api/voice/transcribe/route.ts`). It accepts recorded audio (PCM16 or WAV, size-limited, validated with Zod) and calls the chosen engine, with owner auth like the other voice routes. Wire it to an engine registry. If it's small, add OpenAI batch transcription (/v1/audio/transcriptions) as a second mode; otherwise the registry alone is enough.
3. **Client.** Keep live streaming for `openai`. For batch engines, capture the audio and post it on Send/Done. Show a small note in the mic UI when the fallback was used. The Send/Done UX doesn't change.
4. **Settings.** Add a "Speech to text" section under Settings → Voice with the engine choice. Today only OpenAI is selectable; leave room for "On this computer" and "OpenRouter". Store it like the other owner preferences (see lib/settings.ts and its unreadable-preference test). Reset all data clears it.
5. **Tests.** Engine selection and fallback (fake engines), route validation and auth, audio encoding. No real API calls.

## RESUME: earlier work may exist
A stopped agent may have left uncommitted work in `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-bda54e9d-8afa9823e2e7fab0` (branch `t3/issue-227-speech-engines`; git lists that worktree as locked).
- Inspect it read-only (`git -C <path> status`, `git -C <path> diff`) and bring over what's useful.
- Never modify, unlock, reset or delete it.
- Use your own branch `t3/issue-227-speech-contract`, created from current `origin/main`.
- Commit as soon as the earlier work is applied, and after each step.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 227 --comments`.
- End each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Don't end your turn while a command is still running.** Wait in the same turn.
- **Never kill a process you didn't start yourself in this session, verified by PID.**
- Run one `npm ci` at a time. If it stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- The QA app on port 3100 and the moneo-qa backend are shared:
  - never `npm run qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`;
  - never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`);
  - if 3100 is busy, wait and retry.
- If you add a migration, give it a unique timestamp prefix later than `202611160041`.
- **Run `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` yourself and quote their last lines in your final reply.**
- Also run `npm test` and `npm run build`.
- Use the verify-ui skill for the Settings change. Link the screenshots in the PR body from a commit, then remove them from the branch.
- Push and open a PR to `main`. The body says what changed and why, says "Part 1 of #227" (don't close the issue), and explains how you verified it. End the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

1	---

3	description: Prove a Moneo change works by driving the real QA app the way the owner would, and attach the evidence (screenshots in light, dark and mobile, or a recording) to the pull request. Use after any change to a page, component, style or user flow, when asked to "verify", "show me it works" or "add screenshots", and before opening a PR that changes what the owner sees.
4	---
5	
6	# Verify a change in the running app
7	
8	The owner reviews what the app does, not the diff. "It compiles" and "the tests pass" are not proof; pictures and recordings of the real app are.
9	
10	Everything here runs against the QA app on http://localhost:3100. Never use port 3000; that is the owner's app and data.
11	
12	## 1. Launch
13	
14	`npm run setup -- --qa`, then `npm run qa:auth`, then `npm run qa:server` in the background. It is ready when `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "x-moneo-test: 1" http://localhost:3100/api/health` prints 401 or 200.
15	
16	If port 3100 is already taken, another checkout's QA app owns it and serves that checkout's code. Do not kill it. Start this checkout's app on a free port and point the tools at it with `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:<port>`.
17	
18	## 2. Doctor
19	
20	Run this whenever anything looks off, before changing code:
21	
22	`npm run qa:shots -- doctor home`
23	
24	It fails with the reason when the app is not worth driving:
25	
26	- **"The QA session was not accepted"**: the saved session expired (they last an hour). Run `npm run qa:auth`.
27	- **Every page is the "could not sign you in" screen after a fresh `qa:auth`**: the shared QA workspace holds data this checkout cannot read. Run `npm run qa:reset`.
28	- **A failed request or console error on an untouched page**: the base is broken. Fix or report that first; evidence taken on a broken base proves nothing.
29	
30	## 3. Drive
31	
32	1. **List the pages.** Every route the change can affect, including the ones AGENTS.md "Hit every surface" names.
33	2. **Set up the state.** If a page needs data, create it the way the nearest spec in `e2e/` does. An empty page proves an empty page.
34	3. **Before.** With the change set aside (a temporary commit on another branch, or `git worktree add` of the base):
35	   `npm run qa:shots -- before home money/transactions`
36	   Name pages without the leading slash (Git Bash rewrites `/paths`); `home` is `/`.
37	4. **After.** On the changed code, the same command with `after`.
38	
39	Each run writes `<page>-light.png`, `<page>-dark.png` and `<page>-mobile.png` to `.qa/shots/<label>/`, prints the HTTP status and every failed request or console error per page, and exits 1 if there were any.
40	
41	**A flow, not a page.** A screenshot cannot show a tap, a card being accepted or an undo. Extend the journey spec in `e2e/` that already covers the flow and record it:
42	
43	`npx playwright test e2e/<spec> --workers=1 --trace on --video on`
44	
45	Add a new spec only when no existing journey can take the check (AGENTS.md Tests).
46	
47	## 4. Evidence
48	
49	- Use the path the owner uses: real pages, real buttons. Not a test-only endpoint or a direct database write for the step under test.
50	- Capture the action and the state it leaves, not only the last screen.
51	- Check the side effects next to what is visible: the row written, the history entry, what undo restores.
52	- **Look at every picture yourself.** Read each PNG. Check for overflow, clipped text, unreadable contrast in dark and a broken layout on mobile. A console error or a status of 400 or more is a failure: fix it and shoot again.
53	- When something looks wrong, suspect the capture before the app, and measure the live page before reporting a bug.
54	
55	## 5. Hand over
56	
57	Put before and after side by side in the PR description for each page that visibly changed, with one line on what to look at. Attach the video for a flow. Upload by dragging the files into the PR on GitHub, or ask the owner to if you cannot; `.qa/` is git-ignored, so never commit them. Say which pages you covered, what changed in each and what you could not capture and why. If nothing visibly changed, say so and attach nothing.
58	
59	## 6. Clean up
60	
61	Stop only the server you started, found by its port and this checkout's path, never by name. Leave `.qa/shots/` in place: cleanup removes instances, never the evidence.
